inspection_scope: Independent-variant review of q01–q05 using the supplied ordered native 360×640 frames in captioned and caption-free modes, plus the supplied full-rate pixel-delta observations. Compared behaviorally with retrieved gold payment-burden; no video or audio playback was performed.

q01–q04 show the control changing and nearby paper responses, but q05 shows no subscription-state change, receipt arrival or consequential contact.
q01–q04 contain developing changes and residual paper/Bot movement. q05 is essentially unchanged for its full 2.5-second duration; supplied deltas remain near zero after the variant cut.

q01 and q04 stage the board, Bot and receipt pile clearly. q02 lacks the promised receipt focal point, q03 miniaturizes the board/receipts inside a large empty field, and q05 centers a generic unchanged pricing rectangle rather than the consequential pile.
q01 and q04 communicate bills accumulating without captions. q02 and q05 contain no readable receipt accumulation, while q03 reduces the relevant billing evidence below useful native-mobile scale.

violations.observation: Without captions, there is no visible before/after or billing accumulation; the frame communicates only a pricing comparison.
violations.smallest_correction: Show multiple recognizable receipts accumulating around the Bot and preserve them in the final frame.

sampling_limits: Ordered stills establish sampled poses, state changes, scale and contacts, but cannot independently prove continuous motion, timing nuance, grip tracking or sound. Pixel-delta traces establish periods of painted change or near-stasis only, not semantic motion. Captioned and caption-free renders are visually consistent in the action region; captions do not remedy the identified caption-free meaning failures.
